name: Dr. Aftab Ara
bio: Researcher working at the intersection of human resource management, knowledge management, sustainable development and generative AI. Her recent work examines the ethical implications of generative AI, trust in AI-driven HR systems, and AI in higher education and healthcare.
interests: Human Resource; Knowledge Management; Sustainability Development; Gen AI

name: Dr. Affreen Ara
bio: Machine Learning, DL and NLP researcher with expertise in Emotion AI and lyric-based Music Emotion Recognition. Her work spans end-to-end ML/DL pipelines, hybrid feature engineering (lexicon-based features, embeddings, and attention mechanisms), and both classical and deep learning models.
interests: Machine Learning; Deep Learning; NLP; Emotion AI; Music Emotion Recognition
